title: Zephyr: /pos/cache GET with age_s tracking
description: Return cached peer positions with age in seconds
notes: Implemented bounded 4-peer Zephyr position cache and GET /pos/cache in the existing location module. Updates require authenticated claimed-node equality and policy-matched link-signature or Group OSCORE provenance; private/off broadcasts are rejected, group entries are retained but excluded from the unauthenticated public representation. Enforces coordinate bounds, monotonic observed time, timestamp replay rejection, deterministic oldest eviction, strict 30-minute expiry boundary, privacy fail-closed, and atomic bounded CBOR output containing node/lat/lon/optional alt/ts/age_s. Added focused resource/error tests. Validation: qemu_x86 Zephyr build passed; coap_location_beacon QEMU ztest 10/10 passed including cache auth/privacy/replay, age/bounds, eviction/expiry, and GET response; git diff --check passed. Local smoke uses Zephyr 4.1.0 per AGENTS; no shared CoAP/SenML wiring was touched.
